title: Login Issues - Can't Access Account

title: Payment Failed During Checkout
description: Customer reports that the payment fails every time they try to complete the order.

title: Order Not Showing in Dashboard
description: Customer placed an order but it is not visible in their order history.

title: Email Verification Not Working
description: Customer did not receive the email verification link after signing up.

title: Profile Update Error
description: Customer gets an error message when trying to update profile information.

description: Customer reports that product images are not loading on the product page.

title: Cart Items Disappearing
description: Items added to the cart disappear after refreshing the page.

title: Refund Request Not Processed
description: Customer requested a refund but the request is still not processed.

title: Shipping Address Not Saving
description: Customer cannot save a new shipping address in their account settings.

title: Discount Code Not Working
description: Customer reports that the discount code shows invalid during checkout.

description: Customer says the website takes too long to load pages.

title: Notification Settings Not Saving
description: Customer cannot save changes to notification preferences.
